key_insight: QMage proposes a coherent quantum search for crystal configurations whose Hamiltonian-derived properties meet specified targets within an error tolerance.
engineering_relevance: The framework could support first-principles materials discovery for properties that are difficult to predict classically, but requires mature fault-tolerant quantum hardware.
method: Search over atomic compositions, unit cell structures, and atomic positions.
Block-encode each configuration’s Hamiltonian, isolate a target eigenstate, and evaluate material properties.
Amplify configurations meeting property targets using fixed-point search, then measure candidates.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports logical-qubit and Toffoli-depth cost estimates spanning a classically routine benchmark to targets where established methods are unreliable, rather than experimental materials validation.
watch_item: Practical feasibility depends on fault-tolerant resource demands and reliable eigenstate preparation; satisfying selected property targets does not automatically establish material stability.
paper_title: Quantum Material Generation via Coherent Hamiltonian Search
